unit: PKR at the 100,000 reference notional, all 11,521 trades x 3 strategies

signal_quality.verdict: signals are negative BEFORE costs — the strategy loses even with zero friction; costs then add roughly half again as much

win_loss_asymmetry.note: win rates near 50% for max_tp_step_trailing yet deep losses: average loss per loser dwarfs average win per winner

sizing_and_overlap.method: compare the 60 portfolio scenarios: at the SAME strategy+filter, tighter risk (C_r0_5) loses least and larger allocations (B_25, A_eq3) lose most; overlap/crowding shows up as MORE capital destroyed per trade at loose concurrency (concurrent losers compound)

independent_vs_portfolio.note: per-trade expectancy at 100k notional is -1.2% per trade; any account that keeps taking such trades compounds toward zero regardless of sizing — sizing only changes HOW FAST
